model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the performance of six different language models – mBERT-L2, XLM-L2, mBERT-R2, XLM-R2, mBERT-B2, and XLM-B2 – across several unspecified datasets. The horizontal axis represents the datasets, with labels obscured, and is categorical with no apparent order. The vertical axis represents a metric of performance, labeled “Value,” with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 1.0, incrementing by 0.2, as indicated by the tick labels. For each dataset, there are six bars, one corresponding to each model; each bar also includes an error bar extending vertically from both ends. The mBERT-L2 bars are light blue, with values ranging approximately from 0.2 to 0.6. The XLM-L2 bars are a darker teal, and span from about 0.1 to 0.5. The mBERT-R2 bars are a reddish-brown color, generally ranging from 0.2 to 0.7. The XLM-R2 bars are green, with a range of approximately 0.3 to 0.8. The mBERT-B2 bars are a slightly darker green, typically between 0.1 and 0.4. The XLM-B2 bars are a reddish color, spanning from around 0.1 to 0.5. The bars are visually grouped by dataset, with each set of six bars positioned adjacent to one another; however there is no stacking of any kind. No bars are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, outlining, or annotation.
